title: Top week
goal: Small load bump, reps back down, RPE 8 at most. Last week of the plan — finish strong, then take an easy week before repeating.

wrist.notes: Slightly fewer reps than week 5 so the wrist ends the plan fresh. Note how it feels for the next block.

sessions.title: Lower A
sessions.notes: Add 2.5–5 kg to the squat and RDL if week 5 was clean. Strong but pretty — no missed reps.

exercises.name: Back squat or goblet squat
exercises.notes: High-bar back squat, or goblet if holding the bar bothers the wrist. Cup the DB so the wrist stays stacked.

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift
exercises.load: Straps on. +5 kg if 10s were clean.
exercises.notes: Straps on. Soft knees, long hamstrings, bar close. Neutral grip under the straps.

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squat
exercises.load: Heavier DBs only if balance is easy.
exercises.notes: DBs at your sides, wrists straight. Shorten the stance if the front knee is noisy.

exercises.name: Side plank
exercises.notes: Elbow under shoulder, never on the hand. Hips high. Drop to a knee to make it easier.

sessions.title: Lower B
sessions.notes: Last session of the plan. Best controlled single-leg week, then an easy week before starting again.

exercises.name: Goblet squat
exercises.load: Heavier DB or KB. Last set RPE 8.
exercises.notes: Cup the top of the DB or hold a kettlebell by the horns. Wrist stacked, elbows down. No front-rack barbell.

exercises.name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
exercises.notes: Straps on. Free hand for a light balance touch. Soft knee, hips square.

exercises.name: Reverse lunge
exercises.load: Heavier DBs if the knee is quiet.
exercises.notes: DBs at your sides. Step back, front shin vertical. Neutral wrists.

exercises.name: Suitcase hold
exercises.load: A bit heavier if the torso stays tall.
exercises.notes: DB in one hand, stand tall. Do not lean away. Switch sides each set. Straps are fine.
